{{recipe}}

Thanks to dry falafel mix and the nature of simple salads, this recipe is pretty fast and easy. Look in the bulk bins at your local hippie grocery store for dry falafel mix.

== Ingredients ==
*1 ⅔ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] falafel mix
*1 ¼ cup [[Cookbook:Water|water]]
* 1 head red leaf [[Cookbook:Lettuce|lettuce]], [[Cookbook:Chopping|chopped]]
* 3 [[Cookbook:Tomato|tomatoes]], chopped in bite-size pieces
* 1 [[Cookbook:Cucumber|cucumber]], peeled and [[Cookbook:Slicing|sliced]]
* ½ cup [[Cookbook:Tahini Yogurt Sauce|Tahini Yogurt Sauce]]

== Procedure == 
=== Falafel mix ===
# In a large bowl, add water to falafel mix and stir well.
# Let stand 15 minutes to absorb the water.
# Form mix into ¾-[[Cookbook:Inch|inch]] balls.

=== Cooking ===

====== Baking ======
# Place balls into mini-cupcake tins or onto a [[Cookbook:Baking Sheet|cookie sheet]].
# [[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] in [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] at 375°F for 12 minutes.

====== Frying ======
# Heat about ½ inch vegetable oil to 375°F.
# [[Cookbook:Frying|Fry]] balls until brown and crisp (about 3 minutes).
# Drain and set aside.

=== Serving ===

# [[Cookbook:Mixing#Tossing|Toss]] vegetables with falafels and douse with tahini yogurt sauce. Falafel may be cold or hot for a delicious salad straight outta the PNW.
